title: Software Development Intern (Full Time)
description:
**About Us** 




 Problink Infocare LLP is a software product and services company specializing in web, mobile, cloud, and AI\-powered applications. We build scalable products for clients across multiple industries and provide opportunities to work with modern technologies in a collaborative environment.
 



  





 Position
 



**Software Development Intern (Full\-Time)** 




**Internship Duration** 




 6 Months
 



 Successful interns may be offered a full\-time Software Developer position based on performance and business requirements.
 



**Location** 




 Remote
 



**Eligibility** 



* B.Tech / B.E. (Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related fields)
* MCA
* BCA
* B.Sc. Computer Science / Information Technology
* Recent graduates (degree completed)
* 0–1 year of experience



**Note:** 
 Final\-year students who have not yet completed their degree are not eligible.
 



  





**Required Skills** 




**Basic understanding of:** 



* Programming fundamentals
* Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP)
* HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
* SQL and database concepts
* Git version control
* Problem\-solving and logical thinking



**Knowledge of any of the following will be an added advantage:** 



* TypeScript
* React
* Angular
* Flutter
* Node.js / NestJS
* REST APIs
* PostgreSQL / MySQL
* AWS or cloud fundamentals



**Responsibilities** 



* Develop and maintain web and mobile applications.
* Fix bugs and improve existing features.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code.
* Participate in code reviews.
* Work closely with senior developers and mentors.
* Learn company development standards and best practices.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers and QA engineers.
* Participate in daily stand\-up meetings and sprint activities.



**What We Expect** 



* Strong willingness to learn.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Positive attitude and professionalism.
* Ability to work effectively in a team.
* Good communication skills.
* Commitment to completing the full internship.



**What You'll Learn** 



* Real\-world software development
* Agile development process
* Git workflow
* API development
* Database design
* Cloud deployment
* Code reviews
* Software architecture
* Professional engineering practices



**Selection Process** 



1. Online Programming Assessment
2. Technical Interview
3. Problem\-Solving Round
4. HR Interview



**Important Notes** 



* This is a full\-time internship.
* Successful interns may receive a full\-time Software Developer position upon successful completion of the internship, based on performance and business requirements.
* Candidates with personal projects, GitHub repositories, open\-source contributions, or hackathon experience will be given preference.



**How to Apply** 




 Please submit:
 


* Updated Resume
* GitHub Profile (if available)
* Portfolio or personal projects (if available)
* Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Senior Cisco Service Provider Network Engineer – IOS XR/MPLS
description:
**Job Description: Senior Cisco Service Provider Network Engineer – IOS XR/MPLS**
**Role Summary**
 Act as the technical focal point for complex Service Provider network problem resolution, delivering deep technical leadership across Cisco’s Service Provider portfolio.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Problem Resolution \& Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot and resolve complex customer issues across ASR routing, NCS routing platforms, IOS XR, MPLS, Segment Routing, Broadband, and Optical transport technologies.
* Infrastructure Integration: Provide end\-to\-end infrastructure\-level problem resolution across Layer 2/3 network fabrics, overlays, virtualization, and compute/storage integration.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Deliver thorough RCAs containing root\-cause findings, structured remediation steps, and proactive prevention recommendations.
* Software Escalations: Manage software escalation referrals for critical or recurring issues on IOS XR, ASR, NCS, and related Service Provider platforms.
* Operational Review \& Strategy: Monitor operational trends and collaborate with the High Touch Operations Manager (HTOM) on quarterly technical reviews, findings, operational metrics, and strategic action plans.
* Escalation Management: Expedite critical escalations leveraging deep contextual knowledge of customer network architecture, operational models, and change\-control practices.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with Account Teams, Cisco TAC, Product Business Units, and HTOM to coordinate alignment and resolution strategies.
* Deployment \& Migration Support: Provide remote or onsite deployment support for network rollouts, migrations, and backbone expansions, serving as Lead Engineer across HTTS and TAC teams when required.
* Knowledge Sharing \& Relationships: Build robust customer relationships and contribute reusable tools, scripts, and best\-practice documentation to the engineering organization.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Education \& Experience: BS in a technical field (Computer Science/Electrical Engineering preferred) or equivalent with 5\+ years of related experience; or an MS in a technical field.
* Communication: Excellent verbal, written, and executive\-level presentation skills.
* Autonomy \& Drive: Self\-driven with proven, hands\-on experience resolving intricate technical issues within Service Provider networks.
* Problem\-Solving: Strong diagnostic and probing skills with the ability to work autonomously and independently.
* Methodology: Demonstrated ability to evaluate requirements and formulate solutions within defined constraints, utilizing agile methodologies for rapid delivery, testing, and value realization.


**Technical Skills \& ExpertisePlatforms \& Operating Systems**
* Cisco ASR 9000 and 1000 Series Routers
* Cisco NCS 5400, 5500, 5600, and 6000 Platforms
* Cisco IOS XR Operating System


**Protocols \& Core Technologies**
* MPLS, Segment Routing (SR\-MPLS / SRv6\), EVPN, LDP, Carrier Ethernet, and IP/MPLS Transport
* Routing \& Control Protocols: BGP, ISIS, OSPF, RSVP\-TE, LDP, QoS, CGNAT, BNG, Multicast, and IPv6
* Foundational Networking: TCP/IP, STP, HSRP, VRRP, and Service Provider core/edge architectures


**Tools \& Automation**
* Packet\-level analysis and troubleshooting using tools such as Wireshark
* IOS XR advanced troubleshooting, Model\-Driven Telemetry (MDT), and Cisco Crosswork / CNC / NCS tools
* Network Management Systems (NMS), monitoring, and telemetry suites


**Certifications \& Preferred Advantages**
* CCNP or CCIE Service Provider certification (preferred)
* Working knowledge of Service Provider security, infrastructure protection, and Zero\-Trust architecture principles


 Skills: cisco,ios,mpls,routing,troubleshooting

title: Senior Software Engineer, Flutter
description:
**About The Role**
 As a
 **Senior** 
**Engineer** 
 at Tide you will be working on the designing, creating and running the rich product catalogue. We have a long roadmap ahead of us and rarely run out of interesting problems to tackle.
   

  

 This role offers an exceptional opportunity to make a real difference by taking ownership of engineering practices in a rapidly expanding company! We trust and empower our engineers to
 **make real technical decisions** 
**that affect multiple teams** 
 and shape the future of Tide’s Global
 **One Platform** 
 .
   

  

 We work in small autonomous teams, grouped under common domains owning the micro\-frontends that makes Tide a great application. We self\-organise, gather together to discuss technical challenges, and set our own guidelines on our
 **Community of Practice** 
 regardless of where one currently stand in our Growth Framework. We are focus on deliver a
 **WOW** 
 ! experience whilst ensuring a
 **resilient** 
 ,
 **error\-free** 
 and
 **scalable** 
 codebase.
   

  

**As a Mobile Engineer You’ll Be**
* You will be learning and sharing knowledge with our engineers on new things often, as we believe in experimentation, T\-shaped engineering and collaborative learning for career growth
* You will be working on our new and existing products for our Business Areas. We have an exciting roadmap with brand new features and we will need you to solve interesting problems
* You will have the opportunity to make a difference by leveraging your experience connecting with less experienced engineers, collaborating and cheering together
* You will Joining one of our expanding multi\-disciplinary agile teams, you will work together with product owners, UI/UX designers, architects, engineers, and other business members to translate requirements into well\-engineered solutions
* You will join our Flutter Community of Practices, and your input on how to improve processes and maintain high quality across the team will be very welcome
* Career progression is as important to us as it is for you, and we, therefore, have put in place a Tide Growth Framework to guide you. With our expanding teams and business, we will encourage you to outgrow your initial responsibilities, if you so desire


 Our company is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment, that fosters cooperation in everything we do. This role offers an exceptional opportunity to make a real difference with responsibilities across engineering practices in a supportive and rapidly expanding company!
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
* You have working experience with Flutter as a Software Engineer
* You have experience with popular Flutter libraries, tools and its lifecycle
* You are passionate about building great products in small, autonomous, agile teams
* You have a passion for automation tests and experience writing testable code
* You have demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools and LLMs to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and delivery velocity, and have experience building sleek, high\-performance user interfaces and complex Mobile apps that successfully shipped to customers


**Our Tech Stack**
* We utilise the latest iterations of Flutter and Dart
* We use popular and trusted plugins, packages, and tools, preferring leveraging existing solutions over reinventing the wheel.
* We adopt a modular approach in building our applications, viewing each small package akin to a Lego block. More on our approach can be found here .
* With Melos, we handle an extensive Dart codebase, featuring over 300 packages and around 2 million lines of code.
* We manage state and dependency injection efficiently using flutter\_bloc, get\_it and injectable.
* Our application navigation leverages auto\_route and flow\_builder.
* We approach the backend communication implementation using freezed, json\_serializable, retrofit, and dio interceptors. More about this approach here .
* We heavily rely on code generation with mason and build\_runner.
* i69n is our tool of choice for localisation. You can find how we do it here .
* We're deeply committed to Behaviour Driven Development (BDD) tests, and we use bdd\_widget\_test to help us on that. You can find more here .
* Firebase Suite, DataDog, LaunchDarkly, and Segment assist us in tracking, monitoring, and deploying securely.
* Our CI/CD pipelines and weekly releases are facilitated by GitHub and GitHub actions.


**What You’ll Get In Return**
 Our location\-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
   

  

* Competitive Compensation \- competitive salary and share options
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top\-up options.
* Life \& Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* Volunteering \& Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* Learning \& Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
* Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
* Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
* Snacks \& Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).


**Tidean Ways Of Working**
 At Tide, we champion a
 **flexible workplace** 
 model thatsupports both in\-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.
   

  

 While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face\-to\-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team\-building, where we encourage regular in\-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
